properties.title: General Warning
properties.body:
[The Belts] BALTIC SEA NAV WARN 031/26
LOW SEA LEVEL

THE BELTS: FROM OVERNIGHT INTO SUNDAY TO LATE SUNDAY EVENING APPROXIMATELY -50 TO -60 CM BELOW BALTIC SEA CHART DATUM IN CONNECTION WITH LOW TIDES

WESTERN BALTIC: SUNDAY LATE AFTERNOON TO MONDAY AFTERNOON AROUND -60 TO -70 CM BELOW BALTIC SEA CHART DATUM. THEN RISING.
